//: Story Phase 15: THE BASHFULNESS BRANCH, a small branch of the Grand Bank (Phase 14) that Brogath's concentrated embarrassment wedged into the old quarters (chapter 179). It exists while the story value bashfulness_branch_state is forming, open, flickering or closing: open so long as Brogath remains bashful. Same scale and ledger as the Grand Bank; its customers bring Teller Shift V2 modifiers. The night queue is served by the branch's own teller (the bank command's 'observe'); the relief queue by the captain, as RELIEF GRAND TELLER; the express window is the sash-backed loan. Closed for good in chapter 184 (bashfulness_branch_closed_for_good).

bashfulness_branch.slogan: OPEN SO LONG AS BROGATH REMAINS BASHFUL
